basic_info.description: This detached home is perfectly located just a block from Taraval Street's vibrant shops, restaurants, MUNI lines, and Guerra Quality Meats. Nearby, you'll find Safeway, Parkside Farmer's Market, banks, West Portal Village, the library, playground, and easy public transit on 19th Ave. The top floor boasts an ocean-view layout with a spacious living room featuring an ornate fireplace, a light-filled formal dining room, and a kitchen with northern exposure. It also includes two generous bedrooms, a sunroom or office with stunning ocean views, a full bath with a separate shower and tub, and an additional  bath. An interior staircase leads to additional unwarranted living space including a huge family room, a third bedroom, a second full bath, and a spacious two-car garage with ample storage and potential for expansion. The family room opens to a cozy rear deck overlooking a low-maintenance yard, making this home a perfect blend of charm, space, and convenience!
